message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Cloud console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts → Create service account → grant it BigQuery Data Viewer and BigQuery Job User at project level → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. If your org policy blocks key creation, tell us and hand over a Workload Identity binding instead. Paste the JSON key into a one-time link at scrt.link and email us that link.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this data yourself!
notes: Pull coverage follows the service account's project-level grants; datasets outside them are invisible.
Org policies that block service-account keys require a Workload Identity binding instead.
